title: Automatic In-and-out Water Mini Washing Machine
body_html:
Specification:
Product dimensions: 33 * 27.5 * 27.5 cm
Power:
Rated washing power: 36W
Drying power: 12W
Rated voltage: 12V
Adapter:
100-240V ~ 50/60Hz, 0.8A
Waterproof rating: IPX4
Washing mode: Standard mode; Quick wash mode, Light rubbing wash mode, Deep wash mode, Soaking mode, Cleaning bucket mode, Drying mode
Product features:
Integrated washing and draining function, automatic water in and out;
Mini and lightweight design, easily hidden in corners of the home; Healthy separate washing, liberating hands;
Packaging list:

1 main unit, 1 adapter, 1 instruction manual, 3 adapters, 2 blue cards, 1 universal connector, 1 inlet three-way valve, 1 drainage pipe (1.5 meters long, 2/3 inch diameter), 1 drainage pipe (1/2 inch diameter)
